shared_elements: low-relief carving of curvilinear outlines on a stone surface
enclosed oval/rounded forms suggestive of a face or head (eye-like circles in A)
justification: A shows a large abstract/schematic mask-like face built from spirals and encircled eye motifs filling the boulder, while B shows a row of standing human figures in profile-and-frontal convention with hands raised, wearing long garments, beneath a band of small sign-like marks. Apart from both being incised/relief outline carvings with some rounded enclosed shapes, there is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and entirely different compositional logic (single monumental face vs. registered figural scene).
